fatebound.title: Fatebound key points
items: Line up {Deathmark} and {Kingsbane} with big trash pulls and boss burst windows, and keep flipping {Hand of Fate} coins with 5+ point finishers during them
With 2+ targets, spread {Garrote} and {Rupture} with {Crimson Tempest} and build combo points with {Fan of Knives}. {Deal Fate} grants extra combo points

deathstalker.title: Deathstalker key points
items: Apply {Deathstalker's Mark} with {Garrote} and consume the marks with 5+ point finishers. When {Darkest Night} is active, build to max combo points and use the empowered finisher
Line up {Deathmark} and {Kingsbane} with big pulls, and against many targets use {Fan of Knives} empowered by {Clear the Witnesses}

Rav'i: [광역 피해] Use Feint for the Ravenous Stomp party damage (Wowhead)
[참고] Line up Deathmark and Kingsbane with the Ssscavenging shield window to break the shield fast
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Put Kick (15 sec) into the kick rotation for the three back-to-back Toxic Atrophy casts during Toxic Barrage, and set the order in chat before the pull (Topicx·Wowhead)

[광역 피해] When Uncoil splits the boss into five Writhes, use Deathmark and Kingsbane with Bloodlust, copy Garrote and Rupture onto the Writhes with Crimson Tempest, then hit them together with Fan of Knives (Topicx)
[제어] Stun any Writhe moving toward its Spiteful Hunt target with Kidney Shot. If you are the target, make distance with Sprint (2 min), and clear Spiteful Venom stacks with Cloak of Shadows
Zul'jan: [위치] Reduce the damage with Cloak of Shadows while you body-block a Ritual of the Fang beam. This beam channel is also when the group uses its defensives (Wowhead·Topicx)

[회피] Dodge the spinning Axegrinder axes, but if Ritual Venom is still on you, deliberately clip a slowed axe to clear it. Use Crimson Vial for the armor-ignoring Physical hit and Boneslicer's Physical DoT that follow (Topicx·Icy Veins)

Lightblossom Trinity: [차단] Kezkitt's Light Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Holy) does not need a set kick rotation. Stop it with Kick (15 sec) when it is available (Topicx)
[위치] When you stand in Fertile Loam to block Lightblossom Beam with your body, reduce the damage with Cloak of Shadows (2 min) (Wowhead)
[참고] When the three bosses stand together, copy Garrote and Rupture onto the other bosses with Crimson Tempest
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [광역 피해] Use Feint for Thorncaller Roar (Wowhead)
[해제] If Bloodthorn Roots grabs you, break it with Vanish (Wowhead). Its tooltip makes it a magic effect, so Cloak of Shadows also clears it from yourself

[참고] Bloodlust goes out below 50% when no Bloodthirsty Gaze chase is active (Topicx), so line up Kingsbane and Deathmark (if back) with it. If you are the Gaze target, make distance with Sprint (2 min, 70% movement speed for 8 sec)
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Put Kick in the kick rotation for Warden's Wrath, which repeats on the tank in Moonkin Form (Wowhead kick list)

[위치] If you are marked for Pulverizing Strikes, stand still and aim the cones away from the party. If Grievous Thrash bleed is still up, top yourself off with Crimson Vial before the cones to clear it
[광역 피해] After 40%, press Feint on cooldown through Spirits of the Vale and save Cloak of Shadows for this phase
Ziekket: [차단] Kick the Lashers' Lightspore Shot before they revive, and if several cast at once, stop them together with Blind (Airborne Irritant). Revived Lashers are immune to interrupts and crowd control through Vicious Regrowth
[광역 피해] When the Lashers spawn, the tank holds them in the middle of the pack, so cleave them there with Crimson Tempest and Fan of Knives
[위치] Use Sprint to reach Essence orbs, but do not back up to the far right edge of the platform. Going all the way to the right edge pulls Overgrown Hydra (Topicx)

The Hoardmonger: [광역 피해] Use Feint for Ravenous Bellow (Wowhead)
[해제] If Toxic Spores stacks up from stepping on mushrooms, clear it on yourself with Cloak of Shadows (Wowhead)
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Put Kick into the Fractured Shivercore's Winter's Shroud interrupt rotation, and stop any leftover casts with Kidney Shot
[해제] You can clear the Glacial Torment magic DoT on yourself with Cloak of Shadows
[위치] If you are on Rimeshatter soak duty, use Sprint to step in within 6 sec
Nalorakk: [광역 피해] If you are an Echoing Maul target, the Echo deals heavy Nature damage within 8 yd when it lands, so press Cloak of Shadows (2 min), or Feint if Cloak is down (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Press Feint for the Echoing Fury damage you take while blocking Echoes during Fury of the War God
[참고] Use Crimson Vial if your health is low after Overwhelming Onslaught's three hits and knockback

Kystia Manaheart: [참고] Line up Deathmark and Kingsbane with the 20 sec Destabilized window (Wowhead). Kystia must drop to about 40% in the first window to finish in two, so use both in the first Destabilized (Topicx)
[차단] Take one Mirror Image with Kick and one with Kidney Shot, and when the images are grouped, delay them together with Blind (1 min with Airborne Irritant, all nearby enemies)
[해제] You can clear the Corroding Spittle magic DoT from yourself with Cloak of Shadows
Zaen Bladesorrow: [광역 피해] The second Bloodlust goes out right at the start with the worker pack (Topicx), so line up Deathmark and Kingsbane and spread bleeds onto the workers with Crimson Tempest
[해제] Remove Keen Taskmaster's Back to Work! Enrage with Shiv (30 sec) (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Use Feint for Killing Spree, and if you are the Fire Bomb target, get away from the party quickly with Sprint
Xathuux the Annihilator: [참고] Line up Kingsbane when Demonic Rage makes the boss take 30% more damage, and on the second Demonic Rage, where the third Bloodlust goes out, add Deathmark too (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Use Feint for Infernal Crush, and add Cloak of Shadows if an axe is still alive
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Put Kick in the kick rotation for Chaos Bolt (Wowhead)
[우선 처치] When Furious Vilefiend and Wild Imps spawn, use Deathmark and Kingsbane on the adds, and kill the Wild Imp pack quickly with Crimson Tempest and Fan of Knives (Topicx)
[제어] If Kick is on cooldown, stop Wild Imp's Felfire Burst with Kidney Shot

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Turn on Feint for the Dark Bloom party damage
[회피] If your path to dodge the Void Fissure orbs is blocked, get out with Sprint
Atroxus: [우선 처치] Bloodlust goes out when the first Toxic Creeper appears (Topicx), so put Deathmark and Kingsbane into the Creeper and kill it quickly. Use Kingsbane on later Creepers whenever it is back
[광역 피해] Keep Feint up while Toxic Aura follows Monstrous Roar (armor-ignoring Physical)
[해제] Mind-Numbing Poison is a Poison effect, so you can clear it from yourself with Cloak of Shadows
Charonus: [위치] If you are a Gravitic Orbs target, you are melee, so press Sprint and drag the orb to one of the two Unstable Singularities near the boss (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Press Feint for Cosmic Crash's burst damage
[참고] Vanish breaks Condensed Mass's slow. If the Shadow DoT stacks high while you drag the orb, block it with Cloak of Shadows

The Golden Serpent: [제어] Kill Animated Gold packs with Crimson Tempest and Fan of Knives, and stop the ones close to the boss with Kidney Shot
[광역 피해] Turn on Feint for Serpentine Gust
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Kick the mummies' Wretched Discharge, and stun them with Kidney Shot if Kick is on cooldown (Wowhead). Interrupt Finished Mummies from opened crypts the same way
[광역 피해] Bloodlust goes on Mchimba (Topicx), so put Deathmark and Kingsbane in at the start together with Bloodlust. Use Feint for Awakening Slam (193965 Shadow to the whole party)
[위치] When a party member is Entombed, run to the shaking crypt with Sprint and open it. If you are the Drain Fluids target, refill above 90% health with Crimson Vial to clear Desiccation quickly
The Council of Tribes: [우선 처치] Kula must die before the fourth Whirling Axes (Topicx), so put Deathmark and Kingsbane into Kula and spread bleeds to the Royal Berserker and Honored Raptors you dragged in with Crimson Tempest
[차단] Kick Zanazal's Poison Nova (4 sec cast, 12 sec Nature DoT). If you miss it and get the Poison DoT, clear it from yourself with Cloak of Shadows
[광역 피해] Stack in the middle to split Barrel Through (872842 armor-ignoring Physical split within 7 yd) and keep Feint up. If you are Kula's Severing Axe bleed target, hold on with Crimson Vial
Dazar, The First King: [우선 처치] Bloodlust goes out at the start of Dazar (Topicx), so put Deathmark and Kingsbane into Reban and kill it before 80%. On a four-Bloodlust route, line up the returned Kingsbane on Dazar with the phase 2 Bloodlust
[차단] Kick Reban's Deathly Roar (4 sec cast, Shadow to the whole party and a 4 sec fear). If every interrupt is on cooldown, pre-cast Cloak of Shadows to block the damage and the fear
[광역 피해] Keep Feint up for Gilded Destruction (155172 Fire and a 15 sec DoT) and follow with Crimson Vial. If you are the farthest Quaking Leap target, Vanish can break the chain of leaps

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] The tank interrupts Frigid Shard right after the Hailburst ice lands (Topicx), so keep Kick to back up the tank when its interrupt is on cooldown
[광역 피해] Keep Feint up for the intermission Frost Overload (party Frost damage every 1.5 sec, stacking) (Wowhead), and break the Ice Bulwark shield quickly with Kingsbane and Deathmark
[해제] If many whelps push Cold Claws close to 20 stacks, clear it from yourself with Cloak of Shadows (Wowhead)
Kokia Blazehoof: [차단] Put Kick into the interrupt rotation for Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley (3.5 sec cast, Fire to the whole party)

[우선 처치] The Firestorm must die before the next Molten Boulder (Topicx), so put Kingsbane into it as soon as it appears. When its health runs out, leave the range of Burnout (5 sec cast, 484912 Fire within 20 yd) right away
[광역 피해] Use Feint for the Firestorm's Inferno (Fire to the whole party and a stacking 8 sec DoT) (Wowhead)
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [참고] Most rogue abilities are instant, so you can keep dealing damage near the end of Interrupting Cloudburst. Just avoid applying poisons, which is a 1.5 sec cast

[위치] If you are an Inferno Spit target, go to the platform edge on the side of the next Winds of Change, and press Feint the moment the 6 sec DoT ends and explodes (Topicx). Clearing it with Cloak of Shadows makes it explode on the spot, so do not use Cloak before you reach the edge
[참고] Pour Deathmark and Kingsbane into phase 2, which starts at 50%, and after the merge put them on the boss with lower health (Topicx)

Adderis & Aspix: [광역 피해] Turn on Feint when splitting Thunder and Lightning
[참고] When Storm Blessed moves, reapply Garrote and Rupture on the new target first
Merektha: [우선 처치] When Hatch opens the eggs, wait for the tank to grab the Storm Serpent (Topicx), then put Kingsbane into the Storm Serpent and spread bleeds to the Toxic Vipers with Crimson Tempest
[제어] Free a party member caught in A Knot of Snakes by locking down the snake knot with Blind (Airborne Irritant), and kill the released snakes with Fan of Knives
[차단] Kick Toxic Viper's Poison Spit (Wowhead), and keep Feint up for Serpentstorm
Galvazzt: [광역 피해] Turn on Feint for the Induction party damage
[참고] After your Lightning Spire beam soak turn ends, top off with Crimson Vial
Avatar of Sethraliss: [우선 처치] Put Deathmark and Kingsbane into the Essence Defiler and kill it quickly. Kick Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock

[위치] If you soak a Corrupted Lifeforce, Corruption raises your Physical damage taken by 250%, so clear Corruption with Cloak of Shadows after stepping in. Lock down phase 2 Faithless Tormentors with Kidney Shot and Blind (Airborne Irritant)

200733.d: Blind has 50% reduced cooldown, 70% reduced duration, and applies to all nearby enemies.

408.m: 기력 25 / 연계 점수 1의 5점 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
408.d:
적에게 마무리 일격을 날려 기절시킵니다. 연계 점수에 따라 지속시간이 증가합니다. 최대 8초까지 증가합니다.
연계 점수 1점: 4초
연계 점수 2점: 5초
연계 점수 3점: 6초
연계 점수 4점: 7초
연계 점수 5점: 8초

703.m: 기력 45 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 6 초 재사용 대기시간
703.d:
적의 목을 졸라 18초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 406.35%)의 출혈 피해를 입힙니다.

연계 점수 1점을 얻습니다.

1329.d:
양손의 무기로 적을 공격하여 총 [(전투력의 115%) + (전투력의 115%) * 0.5]의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

연계 점수 2점을 얻습니다.

1766.m: 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
1766.d: 날랜 발차기로 적을 가격하여 주문 시전을 차단하고, 대상이 6초 동안 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하는 것을 방해합니다.

1784.d: 그림자 속에 숨어 취소할 때까지 보이지 않는 상태로 적을 추적할 수 있습니다.

1833.m: 기력 40 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 12 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
1833.d:
적을 6초 동안 기절시킵니다.

연계 점수 1점을 얻습니다.

1856.m: 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
1856.d: 전투 중 시야에서 사라져 은신 상태를 취합니다. 소멸 사용 후 처음 3초 동안에는 피해를 입거나 해로운 효과가 적용되어도 은신이 해제되지 않습니다. 이동 방해 효과에서 벗어날 수 있습니다.

1943.m: 기력 25 / 연계 점수 1의 5점 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시
1943.d:
마무리 일격으로 대상을 찢어 지속적인 출혈 피해를 입힙니다. 연계 점수에 따라 지속시간이 증가합니다.

연계 점수 1점: 8초에 걸쳐 [(전투력의 67.3148%) * 2 / 6]의 피해
연계 점수 2점: 12초에 걸쳐 [(전투력의 67.3148%) * 3 / 6]의 피해
연계 점수 3점: 16초에 걸쳐 [(전투력의 67.3148%) * 4 / 6]의 피해
연계 점수 4점: 20초에 걸쳐 [(전투력의 67.3148%) * 5 / 6]의 피해
연계 점수 5점: 24초에 걸쳐 [(전투력의 67.3148%) * 6 / 6]의 피해
[ 연계 점수 6점: 28초에 걸쳐 [(전투력의 67.3148%) * 7 / 6]의 피해]
[ 연계 점수 7점: 32초에 걸쳐 [(전투력의 67.3148%) * 8 / 6]의 피해]

1966.m: 기력 35 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
1966.d: 회피 동작을 취하여 광역 공격으로 받는 피해를 40%만큼 감소시킵니다. 6초 동안 지속됩니다.

2094.m: 특성 · 15 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
2094.d: 대상의 눈을 멀게 해 1분 동안 방향 감각을 상실하게 만듭니다. 대상이 피해를 입으면 효과가 사라집니다. 한 번에 하나의 대상에게만 영향을 줍니다.

2823.d: 무기에 1시간 동안 유지되는 치명독을 바릅니다. 매 공격 시 30%의 확률로 적을 중독시켜 12초에 걸쳐 [(전투력의 11.374%) * 12 / 2]의 자연 피해를 입힙니다. 중독 효과가 갱신될 때마다 즉시 (전투력의 8.14%)의 자연 피해를 입힙니다. (효과 발동 확률: 30%)

2983.d: 8초 동안 이동 속도가 70%만큼 증가합니다. 은신 중에도 사용할 수 있습니다. [전력 질주: 물 위를 달릴 수 있습니다]

3408.d: 무기에 1시간 동안 유지되는 비치명독을 바릅니다. 매 공격 시 30%의 확률로 적을 중독시켜 12초 동안 이동 속도를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다. (효과 발동 확률: 30%)

5938.m: 특성 · 기력 30 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
5938.d:
[독칼 연마: 독을 바른 칼날 / 보조 무기]으로 공격하여 (전투력의 125.4%)%의 물리 피해를 입히고 모든 격노 효과를 무효화하며, 농축된 형태의 활성화되어 있는 비치명독을 부여합니다.

연계 점수 1점을 생성합니다.

6770.d: 비전투 상태의 적을 공격하여 1분 동안 행동 불가 상태로 만듭니다. 인간형, 야수, 악마, 용족에게만 효과가 있습니다. 대상이 피해를 입으면 깨어납니다. 대상은 하나로 제한됩니다.

8676.d:
적을 급습하여 (전투력의 278%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. [숨겨진 기회: 30%의 확률로 기회가 부여됩니다]

연계 점수 2점을 얻습니다.

14190.d: 연계 점수를 생성하는 공격이 치명타 및 극대화 효과를 발휘할 때마다 추가 연계 점수 1점을 얻습니다.

31224.d: 모든 해로운 주문 효과를 즉시 제거합니다. 또한 망토는 5초 동안 모든 해로운 주문에 저항하도록 합니다.

31230.d: 죽음에 이르는 치명적인 공격을 받았을 때, 죽는 대신 전체 생명력의 7%만큼 생명력이 보존되고, 3초 동안 받는 모든 피해가 85%만큼 감소합니다. 이 효과는 6분에 1번씩만 발동됩니다.

32645.m: 기력 35 / 연계 점수 1의 5점 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시
32645.d:
마무리 일격으로 독을 묻힌 칼날을 적에게 깊숙이 찔러넣어 즉시 자연 피해를 입히고, 대상을 독에 중독시킬 확률을 30%만큼 증가시킵니다. 연계 점수에 따라 피해량과 지속시간이 증가합니다.

연계 점수 1점: [(전투력의 39.5%)]의 피해, [최대(1 - 0, 0)]초 지속
연계 점수 2점: [(전투력의 39.5%) * 2]의 피해, (2 - 0)초 지속
연계 점수 3점: [(전투력의 39.5%) * 3]의 피해, (3 - 0)초 지속
연계 점수 4점: [(전투력의 39.5%) * 4]의 피해, (4 - 0)초 지속
연계 점수 5점: [(전투력의 39.5%) * 5]의 피해, (5 - 0)초 지속
[ 연계 점수 6점: [(전투력의 39.5%) * 6]의 피해, (6 - 0)초 지속] [심오한 책략: 연계 점수 7점: [(전투력의 39.5%) * 7]의 피해, (7 - 0)초 지속]

51723.d:
8미터 내에 있는 모든 적에게 칼을 날려보내 (전투력의 105.88%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 무기에 바른 독의 확률에 따라 적을 중독시킵니다. 대상이 5명을 초과하면 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

연계 점수 1점을 얻습니다.

57934.m: 특성 · 100 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
57934.d: [도둑의 배짱: 대상의 공격력이 15%만큼 증가하고]자신이 생성하는 위협 수준이 모두 대상 파티원 또는 공격대원에게 이전됩니다. 30초 이내에 실시하는 자신의 다음 공격으로부터 시작되며, 6초 동안 지속됩니다. (100밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

79134.d:
목조르기 또는 파열로 자신의 무기에 바르는 독에 영향을 받는 대상에게 출혈 피해를 입힐 때마다 3의 기력을 회복합니다. 첫 번째 출혈 이후로는 기력 회복량이 감소합니다.

자신의 파열에 걸려 있는 적이 죽으면, 남은 지속시간에 따라 기력을 회복합니다.

114018.d: 장막을 펼쳐 30미터 내의 파티 및 공격대원을 어둠으로 감싸 최대 15초 동안 은신 상태로 만듭니다.

185311.d: 연금술 혼합물을 마시고 자신의 최대 생명력의 20%를 4초에 걸쳐 회복합니다.

185565.d:
독을 바른 칼을 던져 (전투력의 23.232%)의 피해를 입히고, 대상을 활성화된 치명독과 비치명독에 중독시킵니다.

연계 점수 1점을 얻습니다.

280716.d: 치명독에 생기흡수 효과를 더해, 생기흡수가 3.0%만큼 증가합니다.

360194.m: 특성 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
360194.d:
적에게 죽음표식을 새겨 16초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 320%)의 출혈 피해를 입히고 80의 기력을 회복합니다. 목조르기, 파열, 치명독으로 대상에게 입히는 피해가 75%만큼 증가합니다.

대상에게 치명독을 걸 때마다 2번 부여합니다.

381623.m: 특성 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간 · 3회 사용 가능
381623.d:
100의 기력을 회복합니다.

기력이 30 미만으로 떨어지면 엉겅퀴 차를 마십니다.

381632.d: 목조르기의 공격력이 50%만큼 증가합니다. 또한 은신 상태나 은신이 해제된 후 6초 안에 사용하면 재사용 대기시간이 발동하지 않습니다.

381637.d: 무기에 1시간 동안 유지되는 비치명독을 바릅니다. 매 공격 시 30%의 확률로 적을 중독시켜 1분 동안 공격력을 (4 *- 1)%만큼 감소시킵니다. (효과 발동 확률: 30%)

381664.d: 무기에 1시간 동안 유지되는 치명독을 바릅니다. 매 공격 시 30%의 확률로 적을 중독시켜 (전투력의 8.14%)의 자연 피해를 입히고 12초 동안 증폭의 독을 부여합니다. 독살 사용 시 증폭의 독 10중첩을 소모해 35%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다. 최대 20번까지 중첩됩니다. (효과 발동 확률: 30%)

381798.d: 생명력이 35% 미만인 대상에게는 출혈, 무기에 바르는 독, 기타 자연 계열 공격이 15%만큼 증가합니다.

381799.d: 자신의 파열에 걸린 적 하나당 민첩성이 2%만큼, 최대 20%만큼 증가합니다.

385478.d: 목조르기의 공격력이 30%만큼 증가합니다. 은신 상태에서 목조르기 사용 시 연계 점수 2점을 추가로 생성합니다.

385627.m: 특성 · 기력 35 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
385627.d:
대상에게 무기의 강력한 독을 주입해 즉시 (전투력의 146.9%)의 자연 피해를 입히고, 추가로 14초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 203%)의 자연 피해를 입힙니다.

왕의 파멸의 영향을 받는 대상에게 치명독을 적용할 때마다 왕의 파멸의 공격력이 20%만큼, 최대 1000%만큼 증가합니다.

연계 점수 1점을 얻습니다.

421975.d:
독살 또는 왕의 파멸이 10초 동안 부식성 분사를 부여합니다. 대상은 하나로 제한됩니다.

부식성 분사에 걸린 대상에게 입히는 자연 피해의 20%를 주위의 다른 적에게 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

452536.d:
마무리 일격으로 연계 점수를 5점 이상 소모할 때마다 운명결속 동전을 던집니다. 앞면이 나오면 15초 동안 혹은 뒷면이 나올 때까지 공격으로 입히는 피해가 10%만큼 증가합니다. 뒷면이 나오면 대상에게 (전투력의 168%)의 우주 피해를 입힙니다.

연속으로 같은 면이 나올 때마다 앞면은 공격력이 추가로 2%만큼, 뒷면은 입히는 피해가 10%만큼 증가합니다. (200밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

454419.d: 절단, 매복, 칼날 부채 사용 시 운명의 낙인이 발동하면 60%의 확률로 연계 점수 1점을 추가로 생성합니다.

457052.d:
목조르기 사용 시 죽음추적자의 징표가 이미 활성화되어 있지 않다면 대상에게 죽음추적자의 징표 3중첩을 부여합니다. 죽음의 표시를 배웁니다.

징표에 걸린 대상에게 연계 점수 5점 이상을 소모하는 공격을 가하면 죽음추적자의 징표 중첩을 하나 소모해 (전투력의 156%)의 역병 피해를 입힙니다.

죽음의 표시
활성화된 죽음추적자의 징표를 대상에게 이전합니다.

457058.d:
대상에게 걸린 마지막 죽음추적자의 징표를 소모하거나 대상이 사망에 이르면 30의 기력을 회복하고 어둡고 어두운 밤이 부여됩니다. 이때 5점 이상의 연계 점수를 소모하여 시전하는 다음 독살이 치명타 및 극대화 효과를 발휘하며, 35%의 추가 피해를 입히고, 다른 활성화된 죽음추적자의 징표가 없으면 대상에게 죽음추적자의 징표 3중첩을 부여합니다.

어둡고 어두운 밤의 효과로 시전하는 독살은 활성화된 죽음추적자의 징표 중첩을 소모하지 않습니다.

457067.d: 칼날 부채가 치명타 및 극대화로 적중하면 8초 동안 칼날 부채 및 혈폭풍의 치명타 및 극대화율이 10%만큼, 치명타 및 극대화 피해는 20%만큼 증가합니다.

1247227.d:
10미터 내의 모든 적을 베어 (전투력의 110%)의 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

적중당한 적에게 부여된 지속시간이 가장 긴 목조르기와 파열을 최대 2명의 다른 적에게 복제합니다.

연계 점수 1점을 생성합니다.

1248970.d:
동전을 7번 던질 때마다 12초 동안 운명을 자신에게 유리한 방향으로 비트는 행운 주화를 갖습니다. 민첩성이 4%만큼, 운명결속 동전의 공격력과 추가 효과가 50%만큼 증가하며, 동전을 던질 때 지난 던지기 시도와 같은 면이 나올 확률이 15%만큼 증가합니다.

행운 주화를 보유한 동안에는 동전을 던져도 행운 주화 발견에 반영되지 않습니다.

1249215.d: 부식성 분사 사용 시 영향을 받는 적에게 5%의 추가 자연 피해를 입힙니다.

1267182.d: 독칼의 기력 소모량이 20만큼, 재사용 대기시간은 15초만큼 감소하며, 사정거리는 3미터만큼 증가합니다.

200733.d: 실명의 재사용 대기시간이 50%만큼, 지속시간이 70%만큼 감소하고 주위의 모든 적에게 부여됩니다.

1: [차단] Put Kick (15 sec) in the kick rotation for Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley (4 sec cast, 174568 Holy to the whole party). Kick only reaches in melee range, so stop it once the Spellsower has walked over to the tank.

[제어] If a Spellsower runs to a dormant Lasher pack with Call The Grove, throw Poisoned Knife (30 yd) to apply Crippling Poison (50% slow), and if it starts Frantic Blooming (8 sec channel), stop it with Kidney Shot (30 sec, up to 8 sec stun). The slow only lands if Crippling Poison is your active Non-Lethal poison.

[광역 피해] Bloodlust goes out once everything is stacked (Topicx). Put Deathmark (2 min) on the long-lived Sporeblight Belcher or Virid Grovekeeper and use Kingsbane (1 min) with it. When the Belcher starts Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec), press Feint (15 sec, 40% less AoE damage for 6 sec).
2: [차단] When both Radiant Spellsowers cast Light Bolt Volley, Kick one and stun the other with Kidney Shot.

[우선 처치] Make a Spellsower your Envenom target and use Kingsbane on it. The Caustic Spatter from Envenom and Kingsbane splashes 20% of your Nature damage onto nearby enemies, so you lose little AoE damage. Press Feint for Spouting Floret.
3: [차단] Split the two Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley between Kick and Kidney Shot. If neither is back, use Blind (1 min with Airborne Irritant, hits all nearby enemies) to delay the cast until Kick returns (Wowhead).

[광역 피해] This pull stacks 12 Lashers, so copy Garrote and Rupture onto 2 more enemies with Crimson Tempest (60 Energy) and spread poisons with Fan of Knives. If Kingsbane (1 min) from pull 1 is back, use it here.

[우선 처치] A Lightgorged Lasher shielded by Lightbloom Pollination (600108 absorb) is immune to crowd control, so Kidney Shot and Blind will not land on it. Make that Lasher your Envenom target and break the shield first.
5: [제어] When Thorny Saptor jumps in with Thornclaw Leap (193965 Physical frontal plus knockback every 2 sec for 6 sec), stun it with Kidney Shot to stop the attacks (Topicx).
[차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast, 3 sec party disorient) (Wowhead kick list).

[광역 피해] Sporeblight Belcher is pulled first and Virid Grovekeeper joins 5-6 sec later (Topicx), so spread bleeds with Crimson Tempest only after the Grovekeeper is stacked. Press Feint for the Belcher's Spouting Floret and the Grovekeeper's Uproot (116379 Nature, knockback).
7: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech. If Kick is spare, also stop Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature).
[제어] For the two Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap, stop one with Kidney Shot and disorient the other with Blind (Airborne Irritant).

[회피] The two Luminous Thornmaws' Solar Breath (3 sec cast, 387930 Holy) is a frontal cone, so stand at a Thornmaw's side or back in melee. If you cannot leave the cone, block the Holy damage with Cloak of Shadows (2 min).
8: [제어] Split the two Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap between Kidney Shot and Blind. If Blind (1 min) from pull 7 is not back, step out of the cone.
[차단] Kick one of the two Leafy Grovecrawlers' Seed Shot.

[광역 피해] Press Feint for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret. While the five Spineshield Beetles' Spiny Shield (500090 absorb) is up, every Fan of Knives hit reflects 4849 Nature back, so drink Crimson Vial (30 sec, 20% max health over 4 sec) when your health drops.
10: [광역 피해] Assassination cannot dispel Potatoad Matriarch's Toxic Spew (2 sec cast, 67888 Nature, then a poison dealing 58189 Nature every 1.5 sec for 9 sec). Press Feint when you see the cast, and if the poison lingers, clear it from yourself with Cloak of Shadows.
[우선 처치] The Matriarch (60 count) lives longest in this pull, so use Deathmark and Kingsbane on it. When a Potadpole Egg appears, switch your Envenom target to the Egg and break it quickly.
11: [차단] One Kick cannot stop all three Lightfeather Petalwings' Disorienting Screech. Kick one and disorient the rest stacked on the tank together with Blind (Airborne Irritant) to stop their casts.
[광역 피해] Press Feint for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret, and dodge Luminous Thornmaw's Solar Breath by standing at its side or back.
12: [광역 피해] This is the last big pull, with six Lightgorged Lashers and six Lashers, so line up Deathmark and Kingsbane here and spread bleeds with Crimson Tempest. Drink Thistle Tea (3 charges, restores 100 Energy) if Energy runs short, and press Feint for Spouting Floret.
[차단] Split the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley between Kick and Kidney Shot. Shielded Lightgorged Lashers are immune to crowd control, so aim Kidney Shot and Blind at a Spellsower.
[우선 처치] When a Lasher pops its Lightbloom Pollination shield, switch your Envenom target to it and break the shield. Caustic Spatter keeps splashing damage onto nearby enemies, so your AoE continues.

1: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast, 135775 armor-ignoring Physical, 30% haste reduction) with Kick (15 sec). If the other kicker misses, stun it with Kidney Shot (30 sec) to stop the cast (Wowhead kick list).
[해제] If Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots (48491 Nature every sec for 20 sec, 10% slow per tick) lands on you, clear the DoT and the slow together with Cloak of Shadows (2 min).

[제어] If the Serpent kicks are covered and Kidney Shot is free, and the Ravenous Descendants stack attack speed with Ravenous Claws until the tank takes heavy damage, stun the Descendant that has been swinging longest with Kidney Shot to drop its 2 sec stacks (Topicx).
2: [우선 처치] Make the Ritual Chieftain your main target and use Deathmark (2 min) and Kingsbane (1 min) on it. Caustic Spatter splashes damage onto the nearby Descendants, so your AoE continues.

[광역 피해] Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the whole group, 162029 heal absorb) is instant and Physical, so Cloak of Shadows cannot stop it. While the Chieftain lives, press Feint (15 sec, 40% less AoE damage for 6 sec) on cooldown to reduce it along with Unstable Totem (29095 Nature every 2 sec), and fill any remaining heal absorb with Crimson Vial (30 sec).
3: [차단] When the three Primal Serpents walk down behind the pillar, take one with Kick and one with Kidney Shot. Delay the last Piercing Hiss with Blind (1 min with Airborne Irritant, hits all nearby enemies) to buy time for another stop to come back (Wowhead).
[우선 처치] Use Kingsbane on the Ritual Chieftain, and press Feint on cooldown while the Chieftain lives to take Blood Sacrifice.
4: [차단] Split the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss between Kick and Kidney Shot.
[우선 처치] Make the Ritual Chieftain your main target and use Kingsbane on it if it is back.
5: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull at 103 trash. Line up Deathmark and Kingsbane on the Ritual Chieftain and copy Garrote and Rupture onto 2 more enemies with Crimson Tempest (60 Energy). Drink Thistle Tea (3 charges, restores 100 Energy) if Energy runs short.
[해제] If the two Twinfang Harrowers' Paralyzing Shots DoTs stack on you, clear them with Cloak of Shadows. Press Feint on cooldown for Blood Sacrifice and Unstable Totem.
[차단] Split the two Primal Serpents between Kick and Kidney Shot.
7: [차단] Kick High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast) (Wowhead kick list). When it starts Evolve (6 sec channel), break it with Kidney Shot to deny the shield and crowd-control immunity.

[광역 피해] Press Feint for Rattling Writhe's Rattle (58189 armor-ignoring Physical every sec for 5 sec). If an Envenom poison DoT (24246 Nature every sec for 8 sec) is still on you at that moment, clear it with Cloak of Shadows.
8: [제어] Stun the Bloodletter that has been hitting the tank longest with Kidney Shot (up to 8 sec) so the blood pools stop growing.
[광역 피해] Press Feint for Rattle, and drink Crimson Vial afterward if your health is low.
9: [차단] Take one High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom with Kick, and break the other's Evolve with Kidney Shot.
[우선 처치] Both Evolutionists must die before the second Mass Envenom, so focus Kingsbane and your finishers on them. Press Feint for Rattle.
11: [차단] Kick the Mass Envenom of your assigned High Evolutionist out of the four. When several channel Evolve together, stop one with Kidney Shot and the rest together with Blind (Airborne Irritant).
[광역 피해] If several unkicked Mass Envenom poison DoTs stack on you, clear them with Cloak of Shadows.
12: [우선 처치] Ascendant Serpent must die before the third Infest, so line up Deathmark and Kingsbane on this mini-boss.
[광역 피해] When Infest hits you (34914 Nature every sec for 5 sec, then 69827 Nature within 8 yd), stay stacked on the tank's marked spot and press Feint just before it bursts.
13: [차단] Mass Envenom from Ula'tek's Chosen must be stopped every time, so save Kick for the Chosen. If Kick is down, stop the cast with Kidney Shot.
[우선 처치] Make the Chosen your main target and use Kingsbane on it. Do not use Crimson Tempest on the six Living Venoms; if they die together, their Venom Burst AoE stacks up (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Press Feint for Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every sec for 9 sec). If Kidney Shot is free during it, stun a Blade of the Altar to stop its Laced Edge teleport.
14: [차단] Kick Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom every time.
[광역 피해] Press Feint for Toxic Surge and top yourself off with Crimson Vial. Use Kidney Shot on a Blade of the Altar to stop its teleport attack.
15: [차단] Split the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss between Kick and Kidney Shot.
[해제] If Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots DoT lands on you, clear it with Cloak of Shadows.
16: [우선 처치] Line up Deathmark and Kingsbane on Ula'tek's Chosen to kill it before the second Toxic Surge, and Kick the Chosen's Mass Envenom.

[광역 피해] The two Ritual Chieftains' Blood Sacrifices overlap with Toxic Surge in this pull. Press Feint on cooldown and fill any heal absorb with Crimson Vial. If your health gets dangerous, block Toxic Surge's Nature damage with Cloak of Shadows.
[제어] Stun a Blade of the Altar with Kidney Shot during Toxic Surge.

1: [우선 처치] This is the Bloodlust pull (Topicx). Put Deathmark (2 min) and Kingsbane (1 min) on the Bribed Captain and kill it first. While the Captain lives, Deep Corruption cuts the AoE damage nearby enemies take by 25%, so favor single-target damage on the Captain over Crimson Tempest.
[광역 피해] If Row Hooligan's Cutpurse (38793 Physical, 155172 Bleed over 8 sec) hits you, survive it with Crimson Vial (30 sec, 20% max health over 4 sec).
2: [차단] Take one of the two Seductive Sayaads' Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient) with Kick (15 sec) (Topicx: one player per Sayaad). If Kick is down, stun it with Kidney Shot (30 sec).
[해제] If Felonious Mage's Fel Missiles (Fire every sec for 5 sec) targets you, cancel it with Cloak of Shadows (2 min) (Wowhead).
3: [차단] Kick one of the two Felonious Mages' Fel Missiles and stop the other with Kidney Shot (Wowhead kick list).
[광역 피해] If the six Felwyrms die together in melee, their Fel Detonations (193965 Fire within 4 yd) stack, so press Feint (15 sec, 40% less AoE damage for 6 sec) as they run out of health.
4: [우선 처치] The four Street Sneaks stack Heartstop Poison on the tank quickly, so spread Garrote and Rupture onto them with Crimson Tempest and kill them fast.
5: [우선 처치] Make the Massive Felwyrm your main target and use Kingsbane on it. Press Feint for Over-infused's Burning Fel (38793 Fire every 3 sec).

[회피] When the Massive Felwyrm casts Massive Fel Detonation as it dies (5 sec cast, 290947 Fire within 10 yd), step out beyond 10 yd from melee. If the Corroding Spittle magic DoT lands on you, clear it with Cloak of Shadows.
[차단] Split the two Felonious Mages' Fel Missiles between Kick and Kidney Shot.
8: [차단] Kick Fel Invoker's Health Funnel (30 sec channel), and when a Wrathguard Flayer enrages with Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast), remove it with Shiv (30 sec) (Wowhead).
[회피] Shivan Punisher's Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 290947 Physical within 12 yd) hits melee, so step out beyond 12 yd, or press Feint if you cannot.
[우선 처치] When the Punisher turns on Demonic Frenzy (29095 Fire every sec) below 50%, line up Deathmark and Kingsbane on it to finish it quickly.
9: [해제] If you are Corrupted Warlock's Drain Life target, break the drain with Vanish (2 min) (Wowhead). If Curse of Doom lands on you and nobody can remove Curses, clear it with Cloak of Shadows.
[차단] Kick one of the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage and remove the other's Enrage with Shiv.
[우선 처치] Put Deathmark and Kingsbane on the Corrupted Warlock and kill it first.
10: [차단] Kick Fel Invoker's first Health Funnel (Topicx). Stop the other Invoker with Kidney Shot.
[회피] Step out of Shivan Punisher's Whirlwind beyond 12 yd or take it with Feint. Use Kingsbane on the Punisher when Demonic Frenzy starts below 50%.
11: [우선 처치] Felmaster Lucsei must die before more than three Blade Dances, so line up Deathmark and Kingsbane on Lucsei (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Press Feint for Blade Dance (43642 Fire every 0.4 sec for 1.2 sec), and use Cloak of Shadows for the next Blade Dance if Feint is not back.
13: [광역 피해] Press Feint for Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (2 sec cast, 145474 Fire to everyone). Line up Deathmark and Kingsbane on the Golem to cut down the number of Slams.
[해제] Kick one of the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage and remove the other with Shiv.
14: [차단] Kick Fel Invoker's Health Funnel, and either stop Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage cast with Kidney Shot or remove it with Shiv once it lands.
[광역 피해] Six Unleashed Imps stack in this pull, so spread Garrote and Rupture with Crimson Tempest and apply poisons with Fan of Knives.
15: [우선 처치] The Corrupted Warlock is pulled back and killed first (Topicx), so use Deathmark and Kingsbane on it. If you are the Drain Life target, break it with Vanish.
[회피] For the separately pulled Shivan Punisher, step out of Whirlwind beyond 12 yd or take it with Feint, and block the Fire damage with Cloak of Shadows during Demonic Frenzy below 50%.
16: [우선 처치] The Defiled Golem's AoE must end within two casts (Topicx), so line up Deathmark and Kingsbane on the Golem.
[광역 피해] Use Feint for the first Defiled Slam and Cloak of Shadows for the second. Kick Fel Invoker's Health Funnel.

1: [해제] When the two Territorial Matriarchs stack Mother's Wrath, remove the Enrage from one with Shiv (30 sec) (Wowhead). Leave the other to a party member with an Enrage dispel.

[광역 피해] This is the first Bloodlust pull (Topicx). Put Deathmark (2 min) and Kingsbane (1 min) on the long-lived Spirit of Hunger, and press Feint (15 sec, 40% less AoE damage for 6 sec) for the Feast of Misery channel (38793 Shadow every sec for 5 sec).

[우선 처치] When the Starvation Effigy totem appears, switch your main target to it and break it before Insatiable Hunger lands twice. If nobody can remove the Curse, clear it from yourself with Cloak of Shadows (2 min).
2: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) (Wowhead kick list). If Kick is down, stop Earth Bolt with Kidney Shot (30 sec).
[해제] Remove Territorial Matriarch's Mother's Wrath Enrage with Shiv.
3: [해제] Remove Territorial Matriarch's Mother's Wrath Enrage with Shiv, and press Feint for Spirit of Hunger's Feast of Misery.
4: [해제] Remove Territorial Matriarch's Mother's Wrath Enrage with Shiv.
[광역 피해] Press Feint for Spirit of Hunger's Feast of Misery, and drink Crimson Vial (30 sec) when the three Keen-Eyed Strikers' Razor Dive bleeds (33944 Physical every sec for 10 sec) stack up.
5: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze.
[해제] Remove Territorial Matriarch's Mother's Wrath Enrage with Shiv.
7: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after the boss (Topicx). Line up Deathmark and Kingsbane, and copy Garrote and Rupture onto 2 more enemies with Crimson Tempest (60 Energy).
[차단] Kick one Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze and stop the other with Kidney Shot.
[해제] Remove the Mother's Wrath Enrage from one of the two Territorial Matriarchs with Shiv.
8: [해제] Remove the Mother's Wrath Enrage from one of the two Territorial Matriarchs with Shiv.

[광역 피해] While Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield holds, it pulses 24246 Nature to the whole party every 2 sec, so press Feint on cooldown and make the Rumbler your main target to break the shield quickly.
9: [차단] Kick one Frigid Mauler's Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast, 50% haste and movement speed reduction on hit) (Wowhead kick list). Stop the other with Kidney Shot.
[광역 피해] This is the second Bloodlust pull (Topicx). Put Deathmark on the high-health Terra Rumbler and use Kingsbane with it. Press Feint for the Rumbling Ward pulses.
10: [차단] Split the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar between Kick and Kidney Shot.
[광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after Bloodlust (Topicx). Use Kingsbane if it is back and spread bleeds onto the Frostfangs with Crimson Tempest.
11: [우선 처치] Avatar of Determination dies first, so use Deathmark and Kingsbane on it. Then switch your main target to the Terra Rumbler (Topicx).
[회피] Pulverize (4 sec cast, stun and 387930 Physical within 12 yd) hits melee, so step out beyond 12 yd when you see the cast. If you cannot get out, press Feint.
[해제] If Glacial Tomb encases you, free yourself with Vanish (2 min) (Wowhead).
13: [차단] Kick one Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning (4 sec cast, 193965 Nature, up to 3 targets) (Wowhead kick list). Stop the other with Kidney Shot.
[우선 처치] When Ruthless Totemcaller's Magma Totem appears, switch your main target to the totem and break it immediately.
[광역 피해] Press Feint for Grizzled Warbringer's Primal Echo (stacking armor-ignoring Physical). The two Warbringers alternate, so if Feint (15 sec) is not back, top yourself off with Crimson Vial.
14: [해제] When a Bonded Beasttamer's pet enters Bestial Wrath, remove the Enrage with Shiv (Wowhead).
[차단] Kick Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning, and switch to each of the two Magma Totems as they appear to break them.
[광역 피해] This pull is the third Bloodlust candidate (Topicx). If Bloodlust goes out here, line up Deathmark and Kingsbane; if you save it for Nanea on high keys, use only Kingsbane.
15: [광역 피해] The four Grizzled Warbringers' Primal Echoes come back to back, so press Feint on cooldown and bridge the gaps with Crimson Vial and Cloak of Shadows. Put Deathmark on one Warbringer.
[차단] Split the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning between Kick and Kidney Shot.
[해제] Remove the Beasttamer pet's Bestial Wrath Enrage with Shiv, and break Magma Totems as they appear.
16: [차단] Kick Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt.

[우선 처치] When the three Volatile Totems appear, switch your main target to them unless Nanea is around 10% health, and finish them on the second wave (Topicx). If Bloodlust goes out here on high keys, line up Deathmark and Kingsbane too.

1: [차단] Voidtouched Magi casts Shadowbolt Volley (4 sec cast, 193965 Shadow within 60 yd) back to back, so if the tank takes the first kick, take the second with Kick (15 sec) (Topicx·Wowhead). Stop any leftover Lava Bolt or Demoralizing Shout with Kidney Shot (30 sec).

[광역 피해] This is the Bloodlust pull (Topicx). Put Deathmark (2 min) and Kingsbane (1 min) on the Voidtouched Magi. If you are the Null Eruption target (4 sec cast, Shadow within 10 yd), step out of the party and take it with Cloak of Shadows (2 min).
[해제] When Feral Saberon turns on its Feral Rage Enrage, remove it with Shiv (30 sec) (Wowhead).
2: [우선 처치] When the three Orbs of Disruption appear, switch your main target to them right away and break them (Topicx). Use Kingsbane on Raj'kess the Spellstorm if it is back.
[광역 피해] Press Feint (15 sec, 40% less AoE damage for 6 sec) for Thundering Storm's long party AoE, and drink Crimson Vial (30 sec) afterward if your health is low.
3: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull at 158 trash. Press Feint for Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (87284 Nature every 2 sec for 10 sec) (Wowhead). Put Deathmark on Chitigoth and spread bleeds with Crimson Tempest (60 Energy).
[차단] Kick Angry Krolusk's Violent Sand (3 sec cast, 155172 Nature to everyone and a 40% slow) (Wowhead kick list).
[우선 처치] When Brutok hits a wall and is stunned for 5 sec by Concussion, use Kingsbane on Brutok (Topicx). Remove Feral Saberon's Feral Rage Enrage with Shiv.
5: [차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yd) is the most important kick in this area, so save Kick for the Screamer (Topicx·Wowhead). Stop Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt with Kidney Shot.
[해제] If you are the target of Watchful Harrower's Void Beam (2 sec cast, Shadow within 8 yd for 4 sec), cancel it with Vanish (2 min) (Wowhead).
[우선 처치] Line up Deathmark and Kingsbane on the Harrower (65 count). Press Feint when you step into the Sky Strike circle to share the hit.
6: [우선 처치] Brutal Overseer's Brutal Slams shield must be broken quickly with damage cooldowns, so line up Deathmark and Kingsbane on the Overseer (Topicx). Each slam raises the party Physical damage by 10%, so press Feint on cooldown.
[차단] Kick Dominated Brawler's Demoralizing Shout (4 sec cast), and stop Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt with Kidney Shot.
8: [차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek. Kick Voidminder's Mending Void (20 sec channel) when Kick is free, otherwise stop it with Kidney Shot.

[우선 처치] This is a cooldown pull (Topicx). Put Deathmark and Kingsbane on the Devouring Brutalizer, but if a mob shows the Devour (9 sec cast) target icon, switch your main target to it and kill it before the cast ends.
[광역 피해] Press Feint for Dreadbellow (4.5 sec cast, knockback and 29095 Shadow every sec for 12 sec).
9: [차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek, and stop Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt with Kidney Shot.
[광역 피해] Kill the ten Scavenging Siphoids together with Crimson Tempest and Fan of Knives, but take the mob with the Devour target icon as your main target first. Press Feint for Dreadbellow.
10: [우선 처치] Put Deathmark and Kingsbane on the Watchful Harrower (65 count). Switch first to any mob targeted by Devour.
[광역 피해] Press Feint for Dreadbellow, and cancel Void Beam with Vanish if you are its target.
[차단] Kick Voidminder's Mending Void, and remove Feral Saberon's Feral Rage Enrage with Shiv.

1: [광역 피해] This is the dungeon's first pull, so Bloodlust goes out (Topicx). Put Deathmark (2 min) and Kingsbane (1 min) on the Shadow-Borne Champion, and spread bleeds to the two Animated Guardians you dragged along with Crimson Tempest (60 Energy). Drink Thistle Tea if you run low on Energy.

[광역 피해] Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow within 100 yd) can one-shot you in high keys (Topicx), so block the first cast by pressing Cloak of Shadows (2 min, resist harmful spells for 5 sec) just before it ends. For the next cast, press Feint (15 sec, 40% less AoE damage for 6 sec) and refill your health with Crimson Vial (30 sec).

[해제] When the Champion turns on its Ancestral Fury Enrage (150% more damage), remove it with Shiv (30 sec). Stun the Minion of Zul on the way with Kidney Shot (30 sec, up to 8 sec stun) to help the purge (Topicx).
